test_list.description: Send reports accessible-enabled false with an empty draft and true with text; while pending it is disabled again.
Activating Send with text calls the window's submit callback exactly once.
Typing text then Return in the message input calls submit (Shift+Return is the newline path; not simulated).
The mode chip label reads plan (asks first) then auto after activation, and mode-index follows.
Activating the $websearch chip appends '$websearch ' to the draft with a separating space.
Attach and Voice input report accessible-enabled false and their labels state why.
The configured default model is selected at start; opening the menu and activating another configured model row and the 'max' effort segment updates model-index and effort-index.
The model menu lists exactly AppOptions.models (ids as rows, labels on the pill); the GUI has no built-in model names.
build_window with an empty model list returns GuiError::NoModels instead of showing an empty menu.
Typing right after the window opens reaches the welcome composer without a click.
